title: Spoiled Treacle Tart

fields.Camp Supplies: 1 Camp Supplies toward a Long Rest.
fields.Eat: Restore 1d4 HP without spending an Action or Bonus Action in combat. Triggers on-heal effects and applies Treacly Tummy for 20 turns. This hidden condition gives Disadvantage on Wisdom and Intelligence ability checks.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
